name: Creta Testimonial Showcase
author: Creta Themes

sections.description:
Creta Testimonial Showcase allows you to showcase customer feedback and reviews in an elegant and customizable way. With its user-friendly interface, you can create, manage, and display testimonials effortlessly.

Features:

  • Add unlimited testimonials.
  • Multiple display layouts.
  • Fully responsive design.
  • Shortcode support for easy integration.
  • Customizable styles to match your theme.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  1. Bootstrap

    • License URI: https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/creta-testimonial-showcase directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the [cretats_testimonials_sc] shortcode to display testimonials on your pages or posts.
sections.faq:
How do I add a testimonial?

Go to the “Creta Testimonial Showcase” menu in your WordPress admin dashboard, click “Add New,” and fill in the required details.

Can I customize the appearance of testimonials?

Yes, you can customize the styles through the plugin settings or by adding custom CSS.
